newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee closes steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee closes steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady in the kerb market at 39.30 to the dollar on Monday on dull buying interest in the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open stable on Tuesday as the demand and supply are well balanced, one dealer at Khanani & Kalia International (Pvt) Ltd said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on August 29, stood at 35.6200/35.7981 rupees to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 9.80 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
